'''M9-08''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Posted at the [[Vaiken Spacedock]], M9-08 relayed to Imperial forces an urgent transmission from [[Darth Malgus]] regarding the reemergence of the ''[[Red Reaper]]'', the flagship of [[Darth Ikoral]].<ref name="TOR" />
